provenance.notes: The kit's buzzer is an unbranded 12 mm, 9.5 mm tall, 2-pin magnetic buzzer with a built-in oscillator (the sealed black bottom SunFounder describes) and a sticker 'REMOVE SEAL AFTER WASHING'. SunFounder gives no datasheet. The closest published datasheet is the Huawha TMB12A05 12 x 9.5 mm active magnetic buzzer, so its numbers are used, but they are not confirmed for the kit's own unit. Primary sheet: TMB12A05 approval sheet (stacktronics.com copy, opened, page 2): rated 5 V, operating 4 to 8 V, rated current at most 30 mA, at least 85 dB at 10 cm, resonant frequency 2300 +/-300 Hz, diameter 12 +/-0.2, height 9.5 +/-0.2, lead pitch 7.6 mm, lead dia 0.6 mm, lead length 6.0 mm. Conflicts between TMB12A05 sheets: Huawha's 2023 product specification (JLCPCB copy, read through a text extract) gives operating 3 to 7 V, 2400 +/-300 Hz and at least 95 dB; its 2021 specification (hebeifangdi.com copy, text extract) gives 3 to 8 V and 2700 +/-300 Hz; a third supplier (XHXDZ) gives 3 to 6 V and 2500 +/-100 Hz. All agree on 5 V rated and at most 30 mA. The primary sheet's 4 V lower limit is used; SunFounder's text says it feeds the buzzer from 3.3 V, which is below that limit but inside the 3 to 7 V sheet, and its Fritzing wiring diagram (1.2.1.png) actually takes the buzzer supply from the T-board 5V0 pin, so the sim should warn rather than refuse below 4 V. SunFounder's page text also reverses the polarity (it says the positive pin goes to the transistor collector and the negative to 3.3 V). Its diagram, like any low-side NPN switch, puts the + lead on the supply and the - lead on the collector. Polarity: the longer lead is + and the body is marked +, per SunFounder's page. Grid mapping: the 7.6 mm lead pitch is 3.0 pitches within 0.02 mm; SunFounder's diagram seats the leads 3 rows apart in the same column, so offsets are [0,0] and [3,0], rigid.
